what_happened: Job 20261027-085452-nm2t ("Judge a PR's candidate head as pending in pr-head and history checks", class of work: code) failed in planning, before any code was written. The planner stopped with error_max_budget_usd: it used up its USD budget cap without finishing. No plan was kept. No acceptance criteria were reported unmet, no checks failed, and no findings were raised. Nothing was delivered or judged.
cause: Planning has a hard USD cap, keeps no partial plan, and has no hold, resume or progress signal. When the cap is hit, all planning spend is lost and the failure shows only as an error string. Nothing sizes a request that touches two checks (pr-head and history) against the planning budget before dispatch. Nothing compares the job's remaining budget with the stage caps at admission. This job was queued on 10-27 and failed on 11-03, so earlier spend or a changed cap may also have shrunk the budget, and nothing shows that. The same gap already appears in an earlier case.
prevention: Two code changes. (1) Before dispatching planning, whether first run or retry, compare the job's remaining budget with the planning cap plus the producer and verifier caps. If it is too small, refuse or hold the job with a clear message instead of starting it. (2) When the planner hits error_max_budget_usd, keep its partial plan and findings and mark the job held, not failed, so a retry resumes from them with a stated cost. Also, when a request spans several checks, require planning to split it into one-check jobs.
proposed_request: Make planning budget exhaustion hold the job instead of failing it. (1) Before planning starts for a job or retry, compare the job's remaining budget with the planning cap plus the producer and verifier caps. If it is short, hold the job and show the shortfall instead of dispatching. (2) If the planner stops with error_max_budget_usd, keep its partial plan and findings, mark the job held with the spend so far, and make the retry command show whether it resumes from the partial plan and what it will cost. Acceptance: a test where the remaining budget is below the combined caps shows the job held with a message and no planner call; a test where the planner hits the cap shows the partial plan kept and the job held, not failed; a retry shows its mode and expected cost before running.
failure: the model chose class "20261029-... ", which is not in the registry
